name: Terrarium 60x40x30
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 60x40x30 cm. Volume: 72.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: A width of 40 cm sets this model apart from the narrower 60 cm long terrariums: the floor has 2400 cm², a third more than the 60x30. The height is 30 cm, the volume 72 liters. It is low and easy to see into, without a 3D background. The outer sides get film, and the front glass panels slide to the side.

A young blue-tongued skink and young tortoises gain the most from the wider floor, because they move over the whole area, not just along the edges. A young ball python has room for two spacious hides and a water dish. A juvenile bearded dragon can start here, but an adult needs a floor of at least 100x40 cm.

The 60x45x30 model offers another 5 cm of width. If you want a similar area with more height, look at the 60x45x50 or tell us the size you need. Film goes on the back and sides, in a pattern of your choice. We finish a special size in 7 to 14 days and ship it by courier.
